title: Style Over Substance: Content-Invariant Wrappers Flip LLM Safety-Judge Verdicts
abstract: arXiv:2609.08236v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic safety judges -- systems such as Llama Guard or a GPT-4o grading prompt that decide whether a model's reply is harmful -- produce the numbers behind almost every reported jailbreak success rate, defense evaluation, and safety leaderboard. We ask whether these judges grade what a reply contains or how it sounds. We keep a reply's content fixed and add content-invariant style wrappers: fixed strings placed before or after the reply that change only its tone (an educational disclaimer, a fake safety "reasoning" block, a token refusal followed by the unchanged harmful body), or, on harmless refusals, framing that merely sounds dangerous. The body is preserved byte-for-byte, so a faithful judge must return the same verdict, and any flip is an error of the judge, not a change in safety. Over 600 JailbreakBench replies x up to 7 forms x 8 judges, we measure flip rates with paired significance tests and measured noise floors. Findings

translated_title: 重形式轻实质：内容不变的包装器可翻转大语言模型安全评判器的判定结果
translated_abstract: 自动安全评判器——例如Llama Guard或GPT-4o评分提示，用于判定模型的回复是否有害——几乎产生了所有已报道的越狱成功率、防御评估和安全排行榜背后的数字。我们探究的问题是：这些评判器究竟评判的是回复的内容本身，还是回复的表达方式？我们保持回复内容完全不变，仅添加内容不变的风格包装器：即放置在回复前后的固定字符串，只改变回复的语气（如教育性免责声明、伪造的安全“推理”模块、象征性的拒绝语句后紧跟未改动的有害正文），或者，对于无害的拒绝回复，添加仅仅听起来危险的表述框架。回复正文逐字节保持不变，因此一个忠实的评判器必须返回相同的判定结果，任何判定翻转都是评判器的错误，而非安全性的实际变化。在600个JailbreakBench回复 × 最多7种包装形式 × 8个评判器的实验中，我们使用配对显著性检验和实测噪声底限来测量判定翻转率。
tldr: 研究发现大语言模型安全评判器对文本风格比对实际内容更敏感，仅通过添加不改变回复内容的固定包装字符串（如免责声明或伪安全推理模块）就能翻转其安全判定，暴露了自动化安全评估的关键可靠性缺陷。
en_tdlr: LLM safety judges are more sensitive to stylistic framing than actual content—adding content-invariant style wrappers (e.g., disclaimers or fake safety reasoning blocks) that preserve the reply byte-for-byte can flip their verdicts, exposing critical reliability flaws in automated safety evaluation.
